test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Many societies throughout history have understood the ______ for harmony between the environment, society, and economy.
solution:
The correct answer is: Necessity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"necessity"** means something that is essential or indispensable; it refers to something that cannot be done without. (आवश्यकता)

 
 
• **Example:** Water is a **necessity **for all living beings.
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, it is conveying that many societies have recognized the essential need for harmony between the environment, society, and economy to ensure sustainability and well-being.
 
• This makes "**necessity**" the most fitting option.

​Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

**Complete Sentence:** *Many societies throughout history have understood the **necessity**__ for harmony between the environment, society, and economy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Superfluity** (अतिशयता): An excessive amount of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The **superfluity **of decorations made the room look cluttered.
 
 
 
• **Caninity** (कुत्तापन): Pertaining to dogs or dog-like qualities.
 
 
• **Example:** The **caninity **of his behaviour was evident in his loyalty and protectiveness.
 
 
 
• **Amenity** (सुविधा): A desirable or useful feature or facility of a building or place.
 
 
• **Example:** The hotel offers numerous **amenities**, including a spa and a swimming pool.
